history.alt_text: A modular smart home hub unit with a heavy locking latch and a stack of maintenance ledger cards on weathered concrete.
history.caption: The alternative to cloud hardware rent is a local maintenance bill paid in hours and power.
history.title: Home Assistant Link Maintenance Bill

style_when: the news is structural and abstract — a stack reordered, a layer added, a flow rerouted — and there is no literal object that carries it, so the idea is stated as a small physical assembly of recognisable parts rather than as bare shapes
prompt: Matte clay 3D render of a small mechanical assembly resting on weathered concrete, asymmetric off-centre composition. Three recognisable engineered parts arranged in a clear physical stack: a modular smart home hub unit, a heavy mechanical locking latch securing it, and a thick stack of maintenance ledger cards docked into the side. Matte surfaces with moulding seams and contact shadows, one directional key light raking across them throwing a long cast shadow, matte muted grey and amber palette, generous negative space.
negative_prompt: text, garbled text, letters, numbers, UI, watermark, typography, lettering
rationale: A matte clay 3D render perfectly visualizes the structural and abstract concept of shifting costs (hardware rent vs maintenance time) using a clear physical assembly of recognizable parts.
subject: a modular smart home hub unit with a heavy locking latch and a stack of maintenance ledger cards
core_thesis: The cloud has become a recurring rent on hardware people already own — and the honest counterweight to it is not 'self-hosting is free' but 'self-hosting is a maintenance bill.'
core_conflict: cloud hardware rent vs local self-hosted maintenance bill
alt_text: Home Assistant Drops Cloud. A modular smart home hub unit with a heavy locking latch and a stack of maintenance ledger cards
caption: Home Assistant Drops Cloud: The push to end subscription lock-in for smart devices.
title: Home Assistant Drops Cloud
